newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - May 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - May 29.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Three fugitives wanted for murder of famous actress's daughter write letter to police saying there are no other accomplices.
Government officials to begin alternating five- and six-day work weeks in 1998.
LIBERTY TIMES - Actress Pai Ping-ping, mother of kidnapped and slain teenager, says Taiwan lacks qualified coroners.
Ruling Nationalist Party and main opposition Democratic Progressive Party discuss proposal to dismantle Taiwan provincial government.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Government to begin offering loans for small- and medium-size enterprises.
Wall Street reaches record high on soaring high-tech shares.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Taiwan dollar falls to lowest level against U.S. dollar in one year.
Communist China reportedly willing to receive nuclear waste from Taiwan.
